sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Biocompatible Dental Ceramic Blocks and Milling Discs

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (Law 1143 of 2007, in force May 2012)
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Alianza del Pacífico, 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Decreto 410 de 1971 (Código de Comercio), arts. 110, 137-140; Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S.), arts. 22 and 45; Ley 526 de 1999 (creación UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006; Ley 2195 de 2022 (transparencia, prevención y lucha contra la corrupción); Decreto 830 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF, administrado por la DIAN; umbral de beneficiario final: titularidad directa o indirecta >=5% del capital o derechos de voto, o control efectivo); Resolución UIAF 164 de 2020 (definición y reporte de Beneficiario Final); Circular Única de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (C.U. 001 de 2021), Título IV (SAGRILAFT); Decreto 4725 de 2005 (INVIMA, registros sanitarios de dispositivos médicos).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the shareholder's country of origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State, UK Companies House)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a party since Jan 20, 2001, under Ley 455 de 1998); consular legalization required for non-Hague Convention states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted by each foreign shareholder to the local incorporator / legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each natural-person shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority of the document holder's country (notarized copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy certified by apostille (when issued as a certified extract); otherwise validated as an ordinary notarized copy with sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified official Spanish translation (Traducción Oficial) of all apostilled foreign documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Traductor Oficial approved by the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular/translator's certification recognized by Colombian Notary Public; no separate apostille needed for the translation itself

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Shareholder bank reference letter / proof of source of funds for capital contribution (AML/CFT source-of-funds verification)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized letter + Hague Apostille (or consular legalization) where the bank letter is issued abroad

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all UBOs, shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and material counterparties against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Colombian 'Lista Clinton' (narcotrafficking/terrorism financing) and national terrorism finance registries, and the local PEP databases under Resolución UIAF 164 de 2020 and Circular Única SIC 2021, Título IV (SAGRILAFT). The S.A.S. must adopt a written SAGRILAFT policy, appoint a compliance officer, and apply enhanced due diligence to PEPs and to transactions equal or above COP 120 million (approx. USD 30,000). Continuous re-screening is required at least annually and upon material events; results must be documented in the incorporation file (banking AML risk tier: Low_Risk_Standard).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social - RUES (www.rues.org.co), operated through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be registered in Spanish with Latin-script characters. Foreign-language elements may be included only as a distinctive sign accompanied by a Spanish translation in the statutes; the registrar rejects identical, confusingly similar, or homonymic names (Decreto 410 de 1971, arts. 110 and 138-140). A pre-approval Certificado de Homonimia (name clearance certificate) from the Cámara de Comercio is mandatory before registration.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Bancario, Seguros, Reaseguros, Fondo de Pensiones, Fondo de Cesantías, Bolsa de Valores, Almacén General de Depósito, Cooperativa (prior Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia authorization required)
Nacional, Presidencia, Ministerio, Superintendencia, Gobernación, Alcaldía, Fuerzas Militares, Policía Nacional (reserved for State entities)
INVIMA, Ministerio de Salud, Clínica, Hospital, Laboratorio Clínico, Salud Pública (regulated health-sector tokens requiring Ministry of Health / INVIMA review)
Names identical or confusingly similar to existing registered trademarks or corporate names (absolute statutory prohibition)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The Certificado de Homonimia is valid for 30 calendar days and cannot be extended as a matter of right; a new application must be filed. On rejection, the applicant may file (i) recurso de reposición before the issuing Cámara de Comercio and (ii) recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, each within 10 business days of notification under Ley 1437 de 2011 (CPACA), arts. 74-76. Subsequent judicial review lies with the Tribunal Administrativo. To avoid delay, applicants may request a secondary alternative name at the time of filing the homonimia application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partial. The S.A.S. must maintain a physical registered office (domicilio social) in Colombia for service of process (Ley 1258 de 2008, arts. 17-18). A virtual administrative address is tolerated only if it includes a physical reception point and authorized personnel for notifications. For this ISIC 3250 manufacturing activity, the production plant must be a physical, dedicated facility compliant with INVIMA Good Manufacturing Practices (BPM); a purely virtual office is NOT permissible for the manufacturing establishment.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (80-90%). INVIMA conducts a pre-registration technical visit and an on-site BPM (Good Manufacturing Practices) inspection of the production facility before granting and renewing the medical-device sanitary registration (Registro Sanitario) under Decreto 4725 de 2005. The Cámara de Comercio and DIAN may perform routine address verifications (10-15% probability in the first year).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance search and Certificado de Homonimia
Pre-RUT registration with DIAN (tax ID pre-allocation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: S.A.S. incorporation documents drafting (bylaws, shareholder resolutions, UBO statements)
Notarization of incorporation document (required if real property is contributed; otherwise private document with notarial acknowledgment)
Commercial registration of the company with the Mercantile Registry (matrícula mercantil and inscription of the incorporation instrument)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff scale based on subscribed capital (benchmark for capital <= COP 30,000,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registry tax (impuesto de registro) when incorporation is executed by public deed
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory rate of 0.7% of instrument economic value (small capital base)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization of foreign corporate shareholder documents (incorporation certificate, good standing, POA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority of country of origin + Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Convention tariffs / MFA service fee per document bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official sworn Spanish translation of foreign documents (Traducción Oficial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Traductor Oficial approved by Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per page / document set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO (RUBF) filing preparation and SAGRILAFT compliance policy implementation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulatory benchmark (filing is free; advisory at market rate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INVIMA sanitary registration (Registro Sanitario) for dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks (medical device, Class IIA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INVIMA Good Manufacturing Practices (BPM) inspection and certification of the manufacturing plant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official INVIMA tariff for on-site BPM verification of medical device manufacturers

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Post-registration Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
Registration and stamping of corporate accounting books (libros de comercio)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regime), arts. 1-50; Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, arts. 110 and 353-372 (mercantile registry); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (trade regulation); Decreto 1069 de 2015 (procedural simplification)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de la S.A.S., filed via the RUES system and evidenced by the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and the provisional NIT/pre-RUT jointly issued by DIAN
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; shares may be authorized, subscribed and paid in installments over a maximum two-year term (Ley 1258 de 2008, arts. 5 and 28), except in-kind contributions, which must be fully paid and evidenced at execution. No mandatory escrow account unless imposed by bank KYC or investor requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST SOLE SHAREHOLDER AND BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. YEAR 2025. The undersigned sole shareholder, in compliance with Ley 1258 de 2008, resolves: 1. To adopt the private incorporation document of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. and to ratify the subscription and payment of 100 ordinary shares of equal nominal value, subscribed as provided in clause 5. 2. To fix the registered office at [address], Bogotá, Colombia. 3. To appoint [NAME] as legal representative (Representante Legal) with the powers granted under order 10 of the bylaws. 4. To appoint [NAME] as deputy legal representative. 5. To authorize opening corporate bank accounts, issuing electronic invoices, and filing the RUT application. 6. To leave the Revisor Fiscal appointment for the statutory threshold.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability and anti-homonymy certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the RUES portal or visit the Chamber window; submit three to five proposed corporate names in order of preference; pay the search fee if required; download the anti-homonymy certificate confirming name availability; the reservation is valid for 30 days pending registration.
required_dossiers: Valid ID or passport scan of each founding shareholder
Legal representative identification document
Completed online name-search form (Formulario de homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is obstructed by an identical registrant or a pending certificate, file a new search with alternative names the same day; no administrative fee waiver is available for re-search.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the private incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders and certifying notary (Notaría) only if real property is contributed; otherwise private instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bylaws containing name, address, corporate purpose including the manufacture of dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks under ISIC 3250, capital terms, shareholder obligations and rights, governance features and legal representative powers; obtain notarial seals if real estate is contributed; collect physical or electronic signatures of all shareholders.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws (Documento Privado de Constitución)
ID or passport copies of shareholders
Contribution schedule evidencing in-kind capital, if applicable
Certificate of marital status of each shareholder where Chamber rules require it
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber requests modifications, the same private document may be corrected by an ancillary shareholder resolution and addendum before presentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry filing with the Cámara de Comercio / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) - Cámara de Comercio of the registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the signed Documento Privado de Constitución plus the RUES registration form, either at the Chamber window or through the virtual platform; pay the registration fee and the 0.7% registration tax (impuesto de registro) over subscribed capital; the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal with the provisional NIT assigned by DIAN.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución)
Fully completed RUES registration form (Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial)
Valid national ID or passport of shareholders and legal representative
Proof of payment of registration fees (may be generated online)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected or suspended, correct discrepancies within 30 days, produce the updated document, and request reactivation; the Chamber must issue its decision within the legal term or the registration is deemed granted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIT and RUT inscription with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the DIAN portal and complete the pre-RUT provided by the Chamber; update the RUT with the definitive registered address and the main activity code ISIC 3250; request the digital certificate (firma electrónica) of the legal representative; obtain the definitive RUT and authorize electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica).
required_dossiers: Provisional RUT (pre-RUT) from the Chamber
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Incorporation document and bylaws
Legal representative's personal RUT or national ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Align personal information with the Chamber database and re-run the registration within ten business days without penalty; escalate to the DIAN contact center if the portal generates an inconsistency code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal registry (ICA) and mandatory social security enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría de Hacienda municipal (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda) and EPS, pension fund, caja de compensación and ARL administrators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company in the municipal registry for Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA) and related business taxes; enroll the legal representative and employees with social security entities; subscribe the workplace risk class corresponding to ceramic manufacturing; activate the payroll platform for payroll taxes and parafiscal contributions.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT certificates
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease or ownership certificate of the operative site
Payroll list and shareholder-employment information for social security registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration triggers an administrative warning; pay the accruing municipal tax plus statutory interest and update the municipal file before undertaking invoicing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate current account (USD/COP) and Swift/Wire/TT activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed credit institution (e.g., Bancolombia S.A., Banco de Bogotá, BBVA Colombia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the certified copy of company incorporation to the chosen bank; complete KYC forms, source-of-funds statements and treasury onboarding; deposit the subscribed and paid capital; request SWIFT/Wire/TT capabilities with corporate treasury services; appoint the legal representative as sole signer and, if required, a second operations officer.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Valid RUT and NIT
Bylaws and incorporation document
Legal representative's ID with proof of address
Shareholders' source-of-funds declarations in bank format
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If onboarding is refused, the bank must issue a written explanation; rectify any updated corporate details and re-submit customer due diligence documents through the compliance window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: INVIMA authorization as manufacturer of dental medical devices
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INVIMA - Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for the manufacturer's Good Manufacturing Practices certificate (BPM, based on ISO 13485) and the sanitary permit or registration of the CAD/CAM zirconia block product (medical device class IIa/IIb); submit the technical dossier, premarket technical equivalence information, labeling, traceability plan and facility declarations; upon approval, obtain the Registro Sanitario for the dental block.
required_dossiers: Application form via ventanilla virtual INVIMA
Quality management system certificates per ISO 13485 or Colombian BPM standard
Technical file including biocompatibility and mechanical test reports for zirconia
Manufacturing plant description and process validation report
Certificate of free sale or bioassay records, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: INVIMA may suspend the term when issuing an official information requirement; respond within 30 days with complete evidence and request a technical meeting; rejection may be appealed within 30 days through reposición and apelación remedies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental impact registration (low-impact) and wastewater discharge permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR); Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente for Bogotá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine the environmental rating of the ceramic plant under Decreto 1076 de 2015; file the Registro de Actividades de Bajo Impacto Ambiental for non-intensive manufacturing; apply for the Permiso de Vertimientos for wastewater generated by wet milling and cooling systems; declare hazardous waste streams containing zirconia dust and obtain the local environmental authorization.
required_dossiers: Technical description of the production line (CAD/CAM milling machines)
Water usage and effluent flow balances
Environmental registration form (full EIA not required at this tier)
Hazardous waste management plan
Company certificate and NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental authority requests additional analyses, respond within the applicable grace period, normally 30 days; conditional licenses may be amended; refusals are appealable before the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire safety and civil defense certificate for the plant
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos or Bomberos Voluntarios of the municipality; Secretaría Distrital de Seguridad in Bogotá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request an on-site inspection to verify compliance with NSR-10 fire safety standards covering exit routes, portable extinguishers, emergency illumination, smoke detection and a civil defense plan; obtain the Certificado de Bomberos or Acta de Cumplimiento de Servicios Preventivos; renew annually.
required_dossiers: Inspection request letter and RUT
Plant layout and evacuation plan
Fire suppression and prevention system designs signed by an engineer
Records of staff training in first-response firefighting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection fails, remedy the non-conformities listed in the report and request a new inspection within five working days; a second non-compliance will trigger an administrative warning and possible temporary closure order.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Occupational safety and land-use / structural conformity certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) and the respective Curaduría Urbana or planning office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the workplace with the ARL and file the SG-SST (Occupational Safety and Health Management System) under Decreto 1072 de 2015; obtain the technical opinion on occupational risks and emergency response; request the Certificado de Uso de Suelo from the planning authority to confirm that the industrial CAD/CAM manufacturing activity is permitted at the physical site and, where relevant, obtain the structural load review for equipment-bearing floors under NSR-10.
required_dossiers: ARL new-business registration form
SG-SST plan and risk matrix
Lease agreement or property title for the site
Uso de Suelo application and current construction or permit documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If occupation is disallowed by land-use rules, evaluate relocating the plant and updating the registered office address; or file an administrative review request with a new technical statement before the planning department.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA - Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (medical devices) and the municipal Chamber of Commerce/industrial registration authorities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivo Médico (Dental CAD/CAM Zirconia Block) supplemented by the Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM) issued by INVIMA

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for centralized oversight; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) or Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente for registration and discharge permits
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: Low-impact industrial activity registration (Registro de Actividades de Bajo Impacto Ambiental); full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) not required for small or medium ceramic milling; wastewater discharge permit is mandatory due to wet-milling effluent
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Resolución 0631 de 2015 (Minambiente): pH 6.0-9.0, total suspended solids (TSS) <= 300 mg/L, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5) <= 300 mg/L for domestic flows; industrial slurry from zirconia milling must not be discharged and shall be treated in closed-loop filters or disposed as hazardous waste per Decreto 4741 de 2005; air emissions (VOCs and particulate matter) per Resolución 0909 de 2008

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos (NSR-10 compliance), structural load inspection of machining areas through the Curaduría Urbana or a certified engineer, and SG-SST occupational health clearance registered with the ARL under Decreto 1072 de 2015

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - the national tax and customs administration of the Republic of Colombia. Official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; taxpayer transactional portal: https://muisca.dian.gov.co; electronic invoicing and validation services operate through the DIAN Sede Electrónica and the e-invoicing habilitación platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign parent establishing a Colombian S.A.S. must procure the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the following sequence: (i) incorporate the S.A.S. before the local Cámara de Comercio and register the legal representative; non-resident shareholders may own 100% of the shares and no local partner is required; (ii) file the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application in DIAN's Muisca portal, attaching the certificate of existence and legal representation, the apostilled and Spanish-translated corporate charter, the power of attorney appointing a Colombian fiscal agent if applicable, and proof of the registered office; (iii) obtain the definitive NIT, which is the single statutory taxpayer identifier for income tax, VAT, withholding tax, customs and electronic invoicing; (iv) update the RUT with the applicable economic activity codes, including ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339114, and confirm classification as a Régimen Común VAT taxpayer and exporter; and (v) activate the electronic signature and obtain DIAN authorization for issuing Factura Electrónica de Venta prior to any invoicing, import or export transaction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box election; an S.A.S. is mandatorily taxed at entity level on worldwide income. Available statutory elections include: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under Articles 903 to 916 of the Estatuto Tributario, optional for S.A.S. entities with gross receipts not exceeding 80,000 UVT (COP 3,983,920,000 using UVT 2025 of COP 49,799), which replaces ordinary CIT and VAT settlement with a consolidated presumptive contribution; (ii) the VAT group consolidation election for economically integrated related entities under Decree 1762 of 2020, subject to DIAN authorization; and (iii) optional presumptive income, depreciation and inventory regimes under the Estatuto Tributario. Hybrid mismatch and permanent establishment anti-abuse provisions applicable in Colombia under Law 2010 of 2019 and Decree 1291 of 2020 operate as mandatory rules rather than taxpayer elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis turnover threshold: a corporate S.A.S. is legally required to register as a Régimen Común VAT taxpayer from the first taxable operation, including an export, irrespective of revenue volume. For natural persons only, the simplified VAT regime threshold is annual gross ordinary income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (COP 174,296,500 for 2025), but this election is not available to an S.A.S. exporter of dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia mandates end-to-end electronic invoicing for all VAT taxpayers and exporters. The S.A.S. must issue Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) through DIAN-habilitated software, software provider or the DIAN free transactional platform. Each FEV must embed the Código Único de Facturación Electrónica (CUFE), or the contingency Código Único de Facturación de Documentos Equivalentes (CUDE), transmit the XML in real time to DIAN validation web services via HTTP/SFTP/JSON or XML APIs, and receive a Validada response or a rejection code (Rechazado) before the invoice acquires fiscal effect. The representation made available to the purchaser must show the DIAN digital stamp, the alphanumeric verification code and a QR code. Export invoices must be transmitted before the corresponding DEX export declaration is submitted, and credit notes, debit notes and dispatch documents follow the same fiscal clearance channel.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks are eligible for the 0% VAT rate under Article 481 numeral 1 of the Estatuto Tributario and Article 17 of Decree 1165 of 2019 where: (i) the goods are sold to a non-resident purchaser and are definitively removed from Colombian customs territory; (ii) the exporter holds a valid RUT/NIT and the INVIMA sanitary authorization applicable to biocompatible dental devices; (iii) the goods are shipped within the deadlines stated in the export operation and the customs authority authenticates the electronic export declaration (DEX); (iv) the zero-rating is reflected in the FEV with the export cause and DEX reference; and (v) any separately invoiced CAD/CAM or digital design services qualify as export of services under Article 481 numeral 3 of the Estatuto Tributario, are rendered to the same foreign principal and are directly connected to the exported goods. Input VAT on zirconia raw materials, milling machinery, packaging and freight may be offset against VAT payable or claimed as refund in the two-month or annual VAT returns after the physical exit of the goods.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX) accepted and authenticated by DIAN in the customs processing system
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing the physical departure of the goods from Colombian customs territory
Foreign exchange repatriation certificate or Declaración de Cambio issued by an authorized Colombian bank evidencing channeling of the export proceeds
Electronic Export Invoice (Factura Electrónica de Venta) with CUFE code and corresponding packing list
Commercial invoice, certificate of origin and INVIMA or health registration certificate for biocompatible dental ceramic products where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN applies automated cross-matching of electronic invoices, DEX declarations, shipping manifests and foreign exchange declarations, and may exchange export data with foreign tax administrations under double taxation agreements or OECD exchange-of-information instruments. Where a zero-rated export is not substantiated, DIAN retroactively reclassifies the operation as a domestic taxable sale at 19%, demands the omitted VAT with default interest, and claws back any input VAT refund already obtained. The exporter also faces the penalty for inexactitude under Article 648 of the Estatuto Tributario, generally equal to 100% of the tax difference and increased to 200% where the claim is based on fraudulent, simulated or non-existent transactions. Directors, legal representatives and fiscal agents may incur liability for use of false documentation and smuggling under Law 1762 of 2015, and the exporter may be removed from the authorized exporter register and suspended from simplified export procedures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia; Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for AML and market conduct; DIAN for foreign trade and customs-related exchange formalities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: COP is freely convertible for current-account payments and receipts, but the foreign-exchange system requires that qualifying transactions be channelled through local authorised intermediaries. Capital account transactions, including paid-in capital from non-resident investors and profit remittances, are permitted if the foreign investment is registered with Banco de la República. Dividend remittances are unrestricted after Colombian income tax and withholding obligations are satisfied; the beneficiary must hold a valid foreign investment certificate. Capital repatriation and profit transfer require an updated registration, otherwise the transfer may be blocked. There are no parallel multiple exchange rates, but a mandatory financial tax along with stamp duties may apply depending on bank debit amount and instrument.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export proceeds from goods, including dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks, must be repatriated and channelled through the Colombian foreign-exchange market through an authorised intermediary. The statutory term for export earnings settlement is six months from the date of shipment, extendable under Banco de la República regulations. The mandatory conversion ratio is effectively 100% of the export FOB invoice value when no prior authorised compensation account is held; if a registered compensation account is used, the exporter must still comply with periodic canalisation rules. Only documented deductions for freight, insurance, and financing costs are allowed against the surrender amount.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMIs are not recognised as licensed credit or settlement institutions in Colombia and cannot hold client funds or open domestic accounts without a local SFC license. They can act only as technical partners or white-label FX providers in conjunction with a licensed Colombian bank, so until a full fintech licensing pathway is used, such EMIs are not a viable primary liquidity rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Colombian SAS with foreign ownership, the legal representative resident in Colombia must appear physically or, at banks that have adopted video-remote onboarding, must complete live biometric/notarised verification. Non-resident directors may sign board minutes and corporate authorisations before a notary and with apostille; in practice, the bank requires original notarised powers, certificate of incorporation, RUES or Cámara de Comercio excerpt, applicant identification, and an interview with the economic beneficial owner whenever the shareholder is an offshore entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder injects paid-in capital without prior exchange registration or without a documented source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide SWIFT MT103 evidencing remitter identity; shareholder registry; corporate resolution approving capital increase; audited financial statements of the parent; net-worth letters; and the duly executed international investment registration Form 1 submitted to Banco de la República through the receiving intermediary. Include the NIT of the Colombian SAS and the exact purpose wording 'capital suscripción en Colombia'.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Manufacturing company shows no local operational footprint, payroll, property, or production evidence, creating an economic-substance red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply the industrial lease contract, machinery import declarations and VAT invoices, production capacity and batch records, local employee payroll and social security remittances, INVIMA sanitary registration for dental zirconia blocks, ISO 13485 certification, inventory ledger, and a narrative business plan for the CAD/CAM block manufacturing project.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: End-customer and supplier payment population includes dental clinics or health-sector actors that may trigger healthcare-fraud and kickback red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain signed distributor agreements, end-customer sales contracts, purchase order history, invoices, delivery confirmations, quality certificates, and evidence that commercial terms are arm's-length. Contemporaneous KYC on counterparties must be documented by both the Colombian SAS and the counterparty's bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transactions are proposed to be settled through tax-haven, sanction-sensitive, or non-cooperative jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a group treasury map showing the ultimate parent, beneficial ownership trust chain, commercial reason for any offshore route, regulatory licences, tax residence certificates, and detailed correspondent banking chain disclosure. The bank should receive a legal opinion on the source of funds and an adverse-media report for every indirect party.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident investor sends USD (or other currency) by SWIFT MT103 to the S.A.S.'s own local commercial account opened as a foreign-exchange intermediation account. The beneficiary is the Colombian company with its NIT; the purpose code must clearly state 'capital foreign investment for subscription of shares in Colombia'. The receiving bank files the exchange declaration and completes the Banco de la República foreign investment registration on behalf of the investor. After registration, proceeds can be converted to COP or retained in a foreign-currency account, and dividend, equity reimbursement, or liquidation proceeds may later be transferred out without exchange controls beyond tax clearance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For imports of raw materials and equipment, use SWIFT MT103 for straight wire payments against commercial invoice and transport documents. For larger vendor contracts, issue an irrevocable documentary letter of credit through a Colombian bank with SWIFT MT700 and a sight or tenor tenor structure. Every outbound disbursement in foreign currency must be submitted to the bank with a declaración de cambio covering imports or services; the bank records the transaction against the company's foreign-exchange file. Payments cannot be released without fulfilling import declaration requirements where applicable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP deliverable forward contracts entered into with authorised Colombian exchange intermediaries and linked to real trade or investment exposure
USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for hedging cash flows not yet physically converted through the foreign-exchange market
Cross-currency swaps between USD and COP related to commercial loans or receivable/payable streams
Plain-vanilla currency swaps with local authorised intermediaries used strictly for hedging real underlying trade transactions, not speculation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of the Mercantile Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March (from 1 January through 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge (1.5% monthly) and a fine up to 15 UVT; persistent non-renewal for five years leads to administrative strike-off, cancellation from the mercantile registry and loss of limited liability protections.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May (in accordance with the DIAN annual tax calendar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or late filing may result in a fine equal to 1% of the company's net worth or up to 10,000 UVT, and the suspension of tax certificates and limitations on exercising commercial activities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory for any S.A.S. that meets any of the following: total assets or gross income ≥ 3,000 times the current legal monthly minimum wage; more than 30 shareholders; listed securities; subject to the control of the Superintendencia de Sociedades; or expressly required by the bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS (NIIF) as adopted by the CTCP; small and medium-sized entities may apply the IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES) under Decree 2420 of 2015.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must file the annual UBO confirmation with DIAN by 31 May each year, confirming or updating every individual who directly or indirectly owns or controls more than 5% of capital or voting rights. Any share transfer that modifies the beneficial ownership structure must be captured in the annual confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Administradores)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday applies to ISIC 3250 (manufacture of biocompatible dental ceramic blocks and milling discs) under current Colombian law. Available incentives include: (i) an income tax discount equal to 25% of qualifying investments in research, technological development and innovation (CONPES-certified projects); (ii) a special 100% deduction for investments in new productive fixed assets placed in service during the taxable year, subject to legal conditions (Law 2277 of 2022); and (iii) certain regional 'renta exenta' benefits for new companies located in special economic zones, generally not applicable to this specific medical consumables manufacturing activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas) filed electronically through the DIAN portal known as 'Muisca' (Servicio Informático Electrónico).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, the return must be filed between the 11th day of August and the 10th day of September of the following taxable year, according to the official DIAN calendario based on the last two digits of the taxpayer's NIT (auto-registration number). For fiscal years ending on a date other than 31 December, the deadline falls on the sixth month following the end of the fiscal period, subject to DIAN scheduling.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income ('Ingresos brutos') arising from the sale of dental zirconia blocks, CAD/CAM milling discs and any ancillary technical services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Colombian S.A.S., even with 100% foreign ownership, report worldwide income on this line because the S.A.S. is a Colombian tax resident entity; exclude only income sourced abroad that is subject to preferential exemption under Colombian law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable income ('Ingresos no constitutivos de renta'), including foreign exchange differences attributable to export receivables that are lawfully excluded and equity contributions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only items expressly enumerated in the Tax Statute (e.g., Article 36, recoverable value of provisions) may be excluded; do not exclude intercompany transfers without supporting transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs and deductions ('Costos y deducciones del período') incurred in the manufacture and sale of dental ceramics, including raw materials, depreciation, payroll, logistics, and royalty payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions are permitted only when costs are necessary and proportional, documented with invoices and contracts, and, for cross-border services or intangibles paid to related non-resident parties, subject to Colombian transfer pricing rules and the 15% withholding where applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income before losses ('Renta líquida ordinaria'), calculated as gross income less deductions and exclusions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This amount forms the base for corporate income tax; no foreign tax credit may reduce this line because the S.A.S. is taxed on Colombian-source income only where foreign-source income is separately excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal loss compensation ('Compensación de pérdidas fiscales') utilized from prior years, subject to the 25% annual limit and twelve-year carryforward period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a newly incorporated S.A.S., enter zero unless a prior tax loss exists from the initial operations; a capital loss from foreign-exchange hedging or asset impairment may be considered only if in accordance with Article 189 E.T.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax liability ('Impuesto de renta') at 35% on taxable net income, reduced by applicable tax credits and prepayments ('anticipos').
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No withholding tax is applied at the entity level; the S.A.S. computes the regular 35% tax and then separately reports the withholding on dividends remitted to foreign shareholders in Form 350.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: a surcharge equal to 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of a month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax; when no tax is payable, the penalty is 1% of gross income or 0.5% of gross assets, whichever is higher, with a minimum of 10 UVT. Interest for late payment runs at the daily default rate (equivalent to 1.5 times the prime rate). Failure to file within 12 months after the statutory deadline may trigger a default assessment by DIAN with additional penalties of 160% of the understated tax and potential criminal exposure.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% for dividends distributed out of profits that have been subject to Colombian corporate income tax at the 35% rate. If distributed out of non-taxable or exempt profits to a non-resident shareholder, the withholding tax is 35% (or 10% when the beneficiary is a resident of a country with a comprehensive treaty that provides such a rate).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must be a tax resident of a treaty jurisdiction, obtain a Certificate of Fiscal Residence (TRC / 'Certificado de Residencia Fiscal') from the competent home authority, legalize it by apostille (or diplomatic legalization for non-Hague states), and provide a sworn affidavit of beneficial ownership to the Colombian withholding agent. This documentation must be submitted and retained by the payer before the dividend distribution date; the withholding agent then applies the treaty rate (often 0% or 5% for dividends) in the monthly withholding return (Form 350). If excess withholding was applied, the foreign beneficiary can file for a refund with DIAN through the 'Procedimiento de devolución' within two years of the year of payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP, patents, technology and know-how: statutory withholding tax rate is 15%; treaty rates are typically reduced to 10% (e.g., Spain, Switzerland) or 0% in limited cases. Interest on cross-border debt: statutory withholding tax rate is 15%; treaty rates frequently provide for 10% (e.g., Spain, United Kingdom, Mexico), and in some jurisdictions 0% if paid to a governmental or financial institution meeting certain conditions. Payment must be certified as arm's-length under the transfer pricing rules to qualify for the reduced rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File documentation is required when the taxpayer's gross income for the immediately preceding year or total gross assets at the end of the period exceed 150,000 UVT (Unidad de Valor Tributario). For fiscal year 2024, with UVT set at COP 45,653, the threshold equals COP 6,847,950,000 (approximately USD 1.65 million at an exchange rate of 4,150 COP/USD).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply a dedicated Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) code comparable to the UAE or other OECD-dependent jurisdictions. However, a taxpayer must satisfy the substantive 'business purpose' and 'substance-over-form' doctrines enshrined in the Colombian Tax Code (Article 658 E.T. and the general anti-avoidance rule of Article 869 E.T.). A S.A.S. used merely as a mail-box or conduit without physical manufacturing premises, qualified local personnel, machinery, purchase orders, warehouse activities, or real R&D in Colombia is at high risk of being recharacterized as an 'empresa fachada' (sham company). Such recharacterization results in denial of treaty benefits, assumption of Colombian PE status, disallowance of deductions, and the application of the controlled foreign company (CFC) regime to the foreign shareholder's attributable profits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting sales of dental zirconia blocks from taxable revenue, underreporting income derived from exports to related foreign distributors, overstating costs through fictitious supplier invoices, or inflating R&D and fixed-asset deductions to reduce the 35% corporate income tax burden.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal liability for tax fraud under Law 1819 of 2016 (amending the Criminal Code): imprisonment from 48 to 108 months and fines equal to 200% of the evaded tax when the amount exceeds COP 1,650 million; administrative penalty under Article 647 E.T. of 160% of the understatement, plus adjusted interest and default interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, financial officer, accountant, and responsible shareholders who participated in or consented to the fraudulent omission are jointly and severally liable for the full unpaid tax and penalties with their personal assets. They also face criminal imprisonment, forfeiture of corporate assets, a travel ban during investigation, and an order of disengagement from any commercial activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Supplying zirconia block raw materials or distribution services to an overseas related party without performing an arm's length analysis, failing to file Form 120 (Local File / Master File) when the threshold of COP 6,847,950,000 is exceeded, or maintaining transfer pricing documentation that is materially incomplete or not disclosed to DIAN.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 260-8 E.T., a transfer pricing adjustment equal to the difference between the OECD-compliant arm's length value and the declared value, plus a penalty of 10% of the adjustment amount. If documentation is not filed, an additional penalty of 5% of the total value of related-party transactions subject to transfer pricing (minimum 1% of gross assets) applies, with a default assessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the statutory auditor who knowingly sign false TP documentation are jointly liable for the penalty and may be barred from acting as administrators for up to 10 years. Travel bans may be issued by DIAN when amounts exceed a material threshold, and criminal money-laundering consequences arise if the mispricing is used to transfer value outside Colombia without justification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Abuse of Corporate Form
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Incorporating the S.A.S. solely to re-invoice dental consumables transactions, or using the entity as an artificial conduit for foreign shareholders to access Colombian tax treaty benefits without real operations, physical plant, employees, manufacturing equipment, product testing, risk-taking, or actual control over the teeth-milling activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. law), the corporate veil is pierced specifically for tax purposes; the shareholders are jointly liable with their personal assets for all unpaid corporate taxes. The general anti-avoidance rule (Article 869 E.T.) allows DIAN to recharacterize the transactions, deny the S.A.S.'s treaty entitlement and impose a penalty of up to 100% of the tax advantage sought. If export operations are fictitious, the entity is liquidated and its assets forfeited.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The directors and shareholders who created or managed the sham structure are personally liable for all corporate tax debts. They may be subject to criminal charges of 'interposition of persons' and fraud, which carry imprisonment up to 10 years; travel bans, freezing of bank accounts, and disqualification from holding commercial licences or export permits are imposed in pending DIAN procedures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the dental block import/export operations to launder proceeds by over-invoicing zirconia shipments, falsifying bills of lading, issuing invoices for non-existent B2B sales, receiving unreported offshore commissions, or structuring wire transfers through low-tax jurisdictions without economic justification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Colombian AML legislation (Law 1121 of 2006, Article 323 of the Criminal Code): imprisonment of 5 to 12 years, fines up to 1,000 (SMMLV), and forfeiture of all instruments and proceeds. Administrative penalties of up to COP 1,200 million (approx. USD 300,000) may be imposed by the UIAF (Financial Information and Analysis Unit) for failures in AML reporting. In the context of international trade, customs fraud penalties of up to 200% of the cargo value are also imposed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, managers and compliance officers who omit anti-money-laundering screening, fail to file suspicious transaction reports (ROS), or knowingly allow the use of the S.A.S. in trade-based money laundering are personally liable and can be sentenced to imprisonment (5–12 years), ordered to pay civil restitution and be subject to confiscation of their personal property. A travel ban and exit restriction is automatically applied during the criminal investigation stage.
